versions.changelog: Names SEOmatic and the approve-first rule; exact tool and task names.

Initial release of seomatic-keyword-research.

- Enables evidence-based keyword research starting from Search Console data and business-provided terms.
- Expands keyword ideas using real search volume, difficulty, intent, and trend data.
- Clusters keywords by intent and maps them to appropriate site pages.
- Offers recommendations on which keywords to target and the order of action.
- Option to stage tasks in SEOmatic for implementation, with clear instructions on approvals.
- Avoids generic or irrelevant keyword suggestions and focuses recommendations on achievable opportunities.
